The independently acquired 441468-byte official reasoning-notes PDF has SHA-256 13b95999f060c0be2142089cfb8b17b75e9231c3c1f3fa0980445ff1b35f0b3b and gives the finite-presentation extraction in Chapter 3, Section 3.11.

Current official root e62211d28e3a9131950c89caa6542cfe5eff3bca and tree 2f8e7ac5ae7f157b6b1de636c2c343b1c7a7e365 yield a deterministic 21022720-byte archive with SHA-256 3022e62ffbed8f5f74d232034a703dc645e6b301879dff1e87df72979914294f.
The current official Lean root and previously locked root 6fefffdbab0dfa726fcfde6cefae23aa7a1888f3 have no common ancestor and remain separate preserved source identities.

status_records.summary: The official release identity, manuscript digest, and current Lean revision are provider-verified; the leaked screenshot's exact source revision is not verified, so source-revision concordance remains incomplete and NSOF-001 remains non-active.

fixtures.summary: The chapter title, Theorem 1.1, Leavitt-algebra presentation, elementary-group notation, page ranges, and 31-entry bibliography are acquired-source transcriptions or bounded paraphrases; only the screenshot title and attribution are screenshot transcriptions.

The Lean target asserts existence of a finitely presented non-sofic group and aligns with reasoning-notes Section 3.11, not verbatim with the main paper's Theorem 1.1 about the binary Leavitt unit group.

failed_routes.summary: Subject and attribution concordance cannot be inflated into byte, page-layout, title, or leaked-draft revision identity because the screenshot title differs and no screenshot abstract or full page is preserved.
The finitely presented existence target cannot be cited as the verbatim statement of paper Theorem 1.1; its official informal source is reasoning-notes Section 3.11.
Provider authentication cannot substitute for trusted Lean replay, source-equivalence review, mathematical certification, or Programme admission.

provider_debt.summary: A known-good Lean 4.32.0 environment must replay the NSOF solution and Comparator target and emit theorem-level axiom reports.
Solve and Cert must review the custom Sofic predicate, finite-test construction, finite-presentation witness, nonvacuity, and every cited group-theoretic dependency before adjudication.
Recovering the standalone leaked draft bytes would be required to establish title, pagination, layout, abstract, and digest identity between the screenshot and that draft.

non_certification_statement: This manifest authenticates and classifies official source evidence only. It does not establish leaked-draft revision identity, kernel correctness, Comparator success, theorem-source equivalence, nonvacuity, mathematical truth, novelty, priority, publication precedence, or promotional authority, and it does not admit NSOF-001 to the active GCL portfolio.
